responsibility: Defines the crate’s procedural derive macros for rustc type-IR traits. This root file registers and implements the generic derives for `TypeVisitable`, `TypeFoldable`, and `Lift`, generating impls over struct and enum fields, honoring derive helper attributes such as `#[type_visitable(ignore)]` and `#[type_foldable(identity)]`, adding the needed interner-related generics and bounds, and rewriting lifted types from interner `I` to `J` when deriving `Lift`.
